title: System and dependency map
footer: Solid: commands/delegation. Dashed: returned state. All components run in-process.
The game and math engines have no Android, Compose or persistence dependencies.

title: Navigation and screen ownership
footer: Pause / Back = Pause control or system Back. Round ends = game over or completion.
Try Again retains the mode. Home disposes the session. Pause/results are not new rounds.

title: Domain state and transition contract
footer: Conceptual fields, not finalized Kotlin signatures. No inheritance or cardinality is implied.
A sealed mode-specific state separates Classic apples from MDAS lives, questions and answers.

title: Session lifecycle: start, pause and resume
footer: Resume is explicit and restores READY or RUNNING according to the state before pausing.
Borders and MDAS self-overlap keep RUNNING; neither deducts lives nor resets the round.

title: Session lifecycle: results, retry and disposal
footer: All four original disposal paths remain: READY, PAUSED, GAME_OVER and COMPLETED.
Retry keeps the selected mode, MDAS difficulty and board profile; a new round starts READY.

title: Commands and ticks: queueing a swipe
footer: Solid: request/command. Dashed: returned state or response. Time flows downward.
One authoritative state; no UI or renderer decides gameplay outcomes.

title: Commands and ticks: commit and publish
footer: Solid: request/command. Dashed: returned state or response. Time flows downward.
One authoritative state; no UI or renderer decides gameplay outcomes.

title: Rendering and adaptive layout
footer: All head, body and tail geometry uses one route. The clock changes visual interpolation only.
Wrap seams use clipped translated copies; MDAS body crossings retain readable answer labels.
